newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps reaffirms Tosco debt ratings.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps reaffirms Tosco debt ratings.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it reaffirmed Tosco Corp's first mortgage bond rating of triple-B and senior unsecured rating of triple-B-minus.
This followed Tosco's acquisition of the Circle K Corp.
Duff had recently said it was reviewing Tosco's ratings for a possible change, but had taken the company off its "rating watch-uncertain" status.
"The company has demonstrated a solid operating performance following the acquisition of Circle K Corp in May 1996," Duff said.

It added that although Tosco's leverage increased as a result of this acquisition, the company's debt service ratios improved due to the cash flow benefits associated with Circle K's established marketing operations as well as strong refining margins during the first half of this year.
